<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion at m/z 183.045 likely corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈182.038 Da. The formula that best matches this mass with only C, H, and O atoms is C₉H₁₀O₄ (exact mass 182.0579 Da, within typical experimental tolerance). No other heteroatoms are indicated by the isotopic pattern. Therefore the molecular formula is C9H10O4.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H10O4</final_answer>
